adoption.rationale: The captured Codex 0.146.1 fixture documents Move to directive syntax. The adopted theorem covers one printable-ASCII destination character; the exact-source replay separately exercises longer representative paths and target routing without claiming an unbounded path proof. At this pin, the adapter surfaces extracted destinations as file_write targets for ProtectedPathRule evaluation.

declared_domain: One ASCII directive line with zero to three leading ASCII spaces or tabs, the exact documented Move to form, and a destination consisting of exactly one printable ASCII character from ! through ~. The Z3 theorem covers this one-character domain. The exact-source regression gate separately checks longer representative destinations, CRLF lines, and a mixed multi-directive envelope; these replays do not extend the formal theorem.
guarantee: For each documented Move to directive with one non-whitespace printable-ASCII destination character, the pinned source regex matches the complete directive line and the adapter surfaces the stripped destination as a file_write target.
input_source: The plain-text tool_input.command string in a Codex PreToolUse apply_patch payload supplied to Doberman.
